description: Utility functions for Android UI components, including view focus, keyboard control, app bar elevation on scroll, text ellipsizing, and drawer closing.

methods.name: Int.dp
methods.description: Converts an integer value to density pixels based on device display metrics.

methods.name: View.requestFocusAndKeyboard
methods.description: Requests focus for a view and shows the keyboard, with focus change handling.

methods.name: View.showKeyboard
methods.description: Displays the soft keyboard for the view.

methods.name: View.hideKeyboard
methods.description: Hides the soft keyboard from the view.

methods.name: View.liftAppBarOnScroll
methods.description: Adjusts AppBar elevation based on scroll position for RecyclerView, ScrollView, or NestedScrollView.

methods.name: TextView.ellipsize
methods.description: Truncates text with ellipsis if it exceeds max lines.

methods.name: DrawerLayout.closeAndThen
methods.description: Closes the drawer and executes a callback after closure.
